beers_list.diazepam: Long-acting benzodiazepine — increased fall and fracture risk
beers_list.alprazolam: Benzodiazepine — cognitive impairment and fall risk in older adults
beers_list.glimepiride: Sulfonylurea — prolonged hypoglycaemia risk in older adults
beers_list.amitriptyline: Strongly anticholinergic — sedation, confusion, orthostatic hypotension
beers_list.diphenhydramine: Strongly anticholinergic — avoid as a sleep aid in older adults
beers_list.indomethacin: NSAID — highest CNS adverse effect profile in its class
beers_list.oxybutynin: Anticholinergic — confusion and urinary retention risk

interactions.detail: Additive bleeding risk. Requires monitoring or dose review.
Substantially increased bleeding risk with dual therapy.
Diuretic-induced volume depletion may impair renal clearance of metformin.

metformin.reason: Withhold around contrast and major surgery
